title: Union-Find (DSU)
learn: parent array, find with path compression, union by rank/size, cycle detection in undirected graphs
hook: Redundant Connection, Number of Operations to Make Network Connected and Accounts Merge are union-find problems, and union-find also powers Kruskal's MST. It's a small data structure that's easy to write from memory.

explain.prompt: Explain union-find: what find and union do, and how path compression and union by rank keep it fast.
keyPoints: every element points to a parent; a root points to itself and names the group
find follows parents to the root; union links one root under the other
two elements are connected iff they have the same root
path compression points nodes on the find path directly at the root; union by rank/size hangs the smaller tree under the larger
together: nearly O(1) per operation (inverse Ackermann)
